title: VTG Praha Prague Czech Souvenir Shot Glass Mini Beer Stein Style Heavy Base
descriptionText:
Praha Prague Czech Republic souvenir shot glass in a mini beer stein shape with handle and weighted heavy base. Features decorative banner graphic reading “Praha Prag” and “Prague.” Great for collectors, souvenir display shelves, European travel memorabilia, or bar themed décor. No chips or cracks. Minor surface wear consistent with age and use. Graphic remains clear and readable.
Approximate measurements:
Height: 2.5 in
Rim Diameter: 1.8 in
Base Diameter: 1.3 in
Weight: ~3 oz
